title: selinum wilhelmsii
intro: Selinum wilhelmsii, commonly known as Wild Carrot or Duk Sang Jeong, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selinum wilhelmsii include its ability to reduce fever, relieve digestive issues, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
